headline.en: From musical scores to editable DAW projects
headline.zh: 从乐谱表演到可编辑 DAW 工程

summary.en: This update adds six papers and their public implementations across editable performance rendering, production graphs, and DAW interaction. Together they connect score, expressive performance, synthesis, effect processing, and project-level editing instead of treating music production as a single generation step.
summary.zh: 本次新增 6 篇论文及其公开实现，覆盖可编辑表演渲染、制作流程图和 DAW 交互。它们把乐谱、表现力演奏、声音合成、音效处理与工程级编辑串联起来，而不是把音乐制作简化为一次性生成。

note.en: MIDI-DDSP separates note, performance, and synthesis controls so musicians can edit each production stage independently.
note.zh: MIDI-DDSP 将音符、演奏表现和声音合成拆成独立层级，让音乐人可以逐阶段编辑。

note.en: WildFX uses a real DAW and plug-in ecosystem to build complex effect-graph data with sidechains, crossovers, and project metadata.
note.zh: WildFX 借助真实 DAW 和插件生态生成复杂音效图数据，并支持侧链、分频与工程元数据。

note.en: SynAPSE represents synthesizer presets as signal-flow graphs and aligns them with audio in a shared embedding space.
note.zh: SynAPSE 将合成器预设表示为信号流图，并与音频对齐到共享表征空间。
